title: Discovery and engineering of avian R2 retrotransposons for all-RNA-mediated targeted DNA integration in human cells - Nature Biotechnology
text:
AbstractTo discover unknown retrotransposons for genomic integration in human cells, we searched 1,139 avian genomes, identified 159 avian R2 retrotransposons and characterized conserved/nonconserved sequence features in their proteins and untranslated region elements. Engineered variants of these retrotransposons achieved up to 60% site-specific gene integration across human primary cells. This work expands the avian R2 resource and provides additional tools for all-RNA-mediated genome editing.

Data availability

The sequencing data involved in this research have been submitted to the Genome Sequence Archive for Human, a platform under the Beijing Institute of Genomics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (available at https://ngdc.cncb.ac.cn/gsa-human/). As of the paper’s publication date, the data will be open to the public, and the accession number for retrieval is HRA013312 (ref. 48). Source data are provided with this paper.
Code Availability

Analytic code for the sequencing data is publicly available at GitHub at https://github.com/YanpingHu/avian_R2 (ref. 49).
